heading: INT. COUNTRY MANOR - GREAT HALL - NIGHT (1789)

units.text: INT. COUNTRY MANOR - GREAT HALL - NIGHT (1789)
A long hall with a vaulted ceiling blackened by two centuries of candle smoke.
A table, laid for a supper no one has touched, runs down the center; tapers gutter in silver branches.
Beyond the tall windows, a thin rain beats the leaded glass.
The air smells of beeswax, wet wool and old grievance.
LORD EDMUND HARCOURT (60s, powdered wig, gout-swollen foot propped on a stool) presides at the head of the table.
To his right, his daughter LADY CATHERINE (20s, rigid in a stiff blue gown, her fan snapped shut) studies her plate.
Opposite sits her suitor, SIR REGINALD FAIRFAX (30s, florid, a ring on every finger), who smiles too much.
Pouring wine with shaking hands is the footman, JEREMIAH POOLE (20s, livery slightly too big).
Reginald, you were saying.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Only that the estate in Kent would suit Catherine admirably.
units.name: REGINALD

units.text: Would it suit Catherine, Sir Reginald? Or would Catherine suit it?
units.name: CATHERINE

units.text: Madam, you misjudge me.
units.name: REGINALD

units.text: Catherine, mind your tongue.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: She sets her fan on the cloth with a click.
Jeremiah's pour wobbles; a thread of claret spills across the linen.
Nobody dares notice.
I shall not marry him, Father.
units.name: CATHERINE

units.text: You shall marry whom you are bid.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: The door at the far end bangs open.
A stranger in a travelling cloak stands in the draught, rain dripping from his hat.
CAPTAIN WILLIAM ASHBY (30s, scarred cheek, a soldier's rigid bearing) removes the hat and bows stiffly.
Forgive the hour, my lord. I come from the Indies, with news.
units.name: WILLIAM

units.text: Catherine rises so quickly her chair falls.
Edmund's face turns the color of ash.
Ashby. You are dead.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: So I have been told.
units.name: WILLIAM

units.text: Sir, this is a private supper!
units.name: REGINALD

units.text: William crosses the hall; Reginald stands, and the two collide at the table's head, shoving, overturning a candlestick.
Jeremiah drops the decanter.
It shatters.
The flames leap on the spilled wine and race across the cloth.
William!
units.name: CATHERINE

units.text: Servant, a bucket! Fetch a bucket!
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Jeremiah bolts for the door and collides with MRS. PYM (50s, the housekeeper, cap askew), who is carrying a bucket already.
Lord have mercy, I smelt it from the pantry!
units.name: MRS. PYM

units.text: She hurls the water.
Reginald and William grapple among the candles while smoke curls toward the vaulted ceiling.
